$comment: Tamper-protection verdicts every implementation of the policy must agree on.
block-hook-tampering.py is the Python one; pi's security extension is a
TypeScript port that cannot import it. Every agent carries every agent's set,
because an agent able to rewrite another's guardrails has removed a constraint
that applies to itself the moment that agent runs.
Paths are given as a tool call would supply them. `~` means the user's home.
